title: シミュレーション工学
subtitle: Modeling and Simulation in Robotics
teachers:
MURAO Toshiyuki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Learn how to simulate a dynamical system using MATLAB.
In particular, apply the MATLAB software to mathematical modeling of a dynamical system, analysis of transient response and frequency response of a dynamic model, and design of a controller.
advice:
We will cover the following topics:

1. How to use MATLAB software
2. Methods for modeling a dynamical system
3. Analysis of dynamic characteristics of a robotic arm
4. Transient response and steady-state response
5. Frequency response through plotting of a Bode diagram and the vector locus
6. Design and analysis of robot control through proportional integral derivative (PID) control
books: We have one textbook. The textbook is written in Japanese.
requiredKnowledge:
Completion of Mathematics for Robotics I and Control Engineering I.
Students should concurrently attend Control Engineering II, which is offered the same semester.

activityGoals.body: Model a dynamical system and simulate its transient and frequency response.
Plot the vector locus, create a Nyquist plot, and use them to check the system stability and properties.
Plot a Bode diagram and use it to check the system stability and properties.
Design and analyze a dynamical system.

achievementLevels.ideal:
Analyze a dynamical system with mathematical modeling and apply analysis techniques to transient response and frequency response.
Use MATLAB to design a controller to satisfy design specifications based on transient response and frequency response.
achievementLevels.standard:
Analyze a dynamical system with the analysis techniques of transient response and frequency response for a given model.
Use MATLAB to design a controller based on transient response and frequency response.
